name: io.github.Mike05102/anime-intelligence-mcp
title: ANIME INTELLIGENCE
description: AI-native Japanese anime collectibles shopping intelligence for autonomous agents: natural-language product discovery, canonical identity, market value, rarity, authenticity risk, BUY/WAIT timing, listing match, deadlines, landed cost, price history and purchase routing. Core discovery languages: Japanese, English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French and German. Paid tools use x402 v2 USDC on Solana; identify starts at 0.005 USDC.
